Fear not, as you cross the Stargate - I shall be with you, as always.'' }} The '''Stargate''' is a [[Point of Interest]] located at {{Location|Black Shores Archipelago}}. ==Overview== The Stargate is a gateway hidden beneath the central waters of the Black Shores archipelago, where data surges endlessly downward like a torrent. By descending through the Stargate, when gravity reverses its hold, the [[Tethys' Deep]] will reveal itself. From here data turns into stars, lighting up the sky beneath. [[Rover]] opens the Stargate in {{Quest|Hidden Between the Waves}} after they and [[Aalto]] restore all the Anchors in the Black Shores Archipelago.{{Quest|Hidden Between the Waves}} :'''''KU-Key:''' The anchor in the TD Observatory has been restored now.'' :'''''KU-Key:''' Aalto and the others have finished repairing the anchor at Veiled Rock too, and they'll be here soon!'' :''[...]'' :'''''Aalto:''' The gateway to the underground has been opened.
